Closure.description:
`closure: { goal: plan:T-01-042, follow: depends_on }`: the open tasks the goal depends on, and the goal. The goal
is a task key, or the key of a collection a source lists (an epic), whose open tasks are then all goals.

Follow.description: `closure:` follows one kind of edge, from a goal task: the prototype board's run order.

LayoutKind.description: How the Field lays a view out: as columns, as numbered steps, or as a graph of the steps.

Sort.description:
`layout.sort` (0.11): a sort key and a direction. `by` is a field the surface can sort on (the Field's `id`,
`title`, `epic`, `labels` and `status`; Tracks adds more), which the surface checks.

exclude.description: Task keys taken out of the view, after the other three are joined.

include.description: Task keys such as `plan:T-01-042`, hand-picked into the view.

profile.description: The profile runs launched from this view get (0.7, Profiles).

queue.description: Feeds a Queue lane (0.10, Planning sources).

where.description: CEL over one task, as text (0.10). Its length is capped at [`MAX_CEL_SOURCE_BYTES`].

workflow.description: The default workflow for runs launched from this view, as `pack/workflow`.

ViewTarget.description: Where a saved view is written: the repo's `.collide/views/`, or the user's own board settings.

description: `task.save_view` params: Save as View (0.11, Filter bar). The view is checked as a view load checks it.

overwrite.description: Replace the file when there is one. Without it a view of the same name is refused.

title: TaskSaveViewParams
